/bin/bash -lc "command -v convert || command -v magick || command -v ffmpeg || true; ls /usr/bin | rg 'svg|chrome|browser|webkit|render'; ls /tmp; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p = Path('payment-sent.svg')
root = ET.parse(p).getroot()
ns = {'s': 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
assert root.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 160 160'
assert root.find('s:title', ns).text == 'Payment sent'
assert root.find('.//s:path[@pathLength=\"1\"]', ns) is not None
style = root.find('s:style', ns).text
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in style
assert 'infinite' not in style
assert '420ms' in style and '400ms' in style
assert not root.findall('.//s:script', ns)
assert not root.findall('.//s:image', ns)
print(f'Valid standalone SVG: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes; one-shot animation ends at 820ms.')
PY"
